proposed statement: Parents struggle to get information from the school because fee statements are printed and sent home in learner's bags but half never reach parents
key statement: SchoolBase 7 (from about 2014) runs on a server in the admin block. It holds learners, parents, fees and marks, exports CSV, produces the report PDFs, and sends the emails.

proposed statement: The portal must handle 1,400 parent contacts without crashing when reports are released, as the website crashed during a test with one grade's reports
key statement: On report day every parent logs in within a couple of hours, mostly in the evening, from about 1,650 parent contacts (corrected from 1,400). Last year a one-grade test of reports on the website took the site down.

proposed statement: The portal needs to know how out of date the balances would be if it uses a nightly CSV export from Schoolbase
key statement: The consultant proposed feeding the portal from a nightly CSV export from SchoolBase, so SchoolBase itself is never touched.

proposed statement: Most parents have smartphones but data is expensive, and many are on prepaid plans, so the portal must be light and small pages with PDFs only downloaded when opened
key statement: Most parents would use the portal on their phones rather than a computer. Graham believes so, but the school has never asked; to be checked.

proposed statement: Most parents have smartphones but data is expensive, and many are on prepaid plans, so the portal must be light and small pages with PDFs only downloaded when opened
key statement: The portal must be light on mobile data (small pages, PDFs downloaded only when opened), because data is expensive for parents (Graham reckons most are on prepaid) and bursary families count every megabyte.

proposed statement: The portal must use the school's maroon color scheme instead of generic blue
key statement: Use the school's maroon, not a generic blue.

proposed statement: The school has only one IT person who works two days a week, creating a risk of no one to fix issues during report nights
